description: Read specs/008-autonomous-response.md and docs/roadmap.md first. Prioritize completing the autonomous signal-to-verified-deployment flow, official CLI adapters, owner-scoped compliant routing, and durable coordination. Do not propose unrelated agent-loop features or subscription credential brokerage. Assess the state of feature implementation tasks. Read the current tasks/response-tasks.json on the configured task branch (or check if it is empty). If all current feature tasks are completed (or none exist), research the codebase, open issues, and project roadmap to identify 3-5 new features to implement. Write the new tasks as a JSON array to `.wreck-it/plans/response-tasks.json--assessor.json` on the main branch. Each task must be a valid wreck-it task object with id, description, status (pending), role, phase, depends_on, priority, and complexity fields. New features should include implementation tasks, test tasks, and evaluation tasks following the ideas/implementer/evaluator pattern. The wreck-it headless runner will automatically migrate the plan into the configured response task file.
precondition_prompt: Read response-tasks.json and check if all tasks have status 'completed'. If every task is completed (or the file is empty/contains no tasks), this task should run to generate new feature work. If any tasks are still 'pending' or 'inprogress', skip this task.
